# Route Mobile (ROUTE) — Q4 FY26 Results from Exchange Filings

**Board Meeting: May 7, 2026** | Period ended March 31, 2026

---

## Key Financials — Q4 FY26

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Revenue from operations** | **₹1,130.9 crore** (₹11,309 Mn) [1] |
| **Net profit (PAT)** | **₹114.43 crore** [2] |
| **YoY PAT growth** | **+89.8%** [2] |
| **Revenue change** | +2.2% QoQ, −3.8% YoY [1] |
| **Final Dividend recommended** | **₹2.00 per equity share** [3] |

## Dividend Details

The Board **recommended a Final Dividend of ₹2 per equity share** for FY26 at its meeting on May 7, 2026 [3]. This is subject to shareholder approval. Total dividend per share for FY26 stands at **₹12.00** (including the interim dividends paid earlier), implying a dividend yield of **~2.3%** at the current price of ₹518 [4].

Source: Exchange filings (NSE/BSE) + reported financials [1][2][3][4]

## Key Takeaways

1. **Revenue** came in at ₹1,130.9 crore for Q4 — modest QoQ growth (+2.2%) but a slight YoY decline (−3.8%) [1].
2. **PAT surged ~90% YoY** to ₹114.4 crore, suggesting strong operating leverage / cost discipline [2].
3. **Final Dividend of ₹2/share** recommended (subject to AGM approval), taking the full-year payout to ₹12 DPS [3].
4. The company carries **near-zero debt** (D/E 0.015) with strong FCF of ₹662 crore — solid financial position [4].
5. Trading at **P/E of 13.7×** with ROE of ~9.7% — valuation looks reasonable for a cash-generative CPaaS player [4].
